title: Plant Manager
text:
### **Position Summary**

The Plant Manager is responsible for overseeing daily department operations, leading warehouse team members, and ensuring manufacturing objectives are met safely, efficiently, and within established quality standards. This position plays a key role in driving continuous improvement, managing departmental performance, developing employees, and aligning production activities with overall plant goals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, business acumen, problem-solving skills, and the ability to make independent decisions that support operational success.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and promote the company's safety programs to maintain a safe, healthy, and accident-free work environment.
* Manage daily department operations and direct the work of assigned employees and subordinate supervisors, as applicable.
* Establish clear expectations, performance standards, and accountability for team members.
* Provide leadership in employee relations matters, including addressing grievances, resolving complaints, and recommending appropriate personnel actions.
* Communicate departmental and plant-wide goals, priorities, and performance expectations effectively.
* Review production orders, schedules, product specifications, quantities, and delivery requirements to plan departmental operations.
* Establish production priorities, sequencing, and schedules to support manufacturing efficiency and customer requirements.
* Coordinate manufacturing activities to ensure production and quality standards are consistently achieved.
* Monitor production scrap, operating reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Identify and resolve operational, manufacturing, and maintenance issues to minimize costs, reduce delays, and improve productivity.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, and operational excellence.
* Monitor departmental performance and business metrics to support overall plant and company objectives.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 3–5 years of recent supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience with continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
* Strong business acumen, including an understanding of profit and loss (P&L), KPIs, and business performance metrics.
* Proven ability to build effective teams, establish expectations, and hold employees accountable.
* Strong production knowledge and the ability to lead, motivate, and develop team members.
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to exercise independent judgment within the scope of departmental responsibilities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with individuals and groups.
* Ability to understand and work with mathematical equations and production data.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in distribution warehouses.
* Experience with ERP systems and ERP implementation.
* Experience using production data and operational metrics to drive business decisions and continuous improvement.

### **Leadership Expectations**

The Plant Manager is expected to lead by example, foster a positive and accountable work environment, develop team capabilities, and consistently support the company's safety, quality, delivery, and productivity objectives.

**About Us**

Gibraltar Building Products is a leading North American building products manufacturer, with several manufacturing facilities across the United States and Canada. As the top supplier in the residential roof ventilation, drainage and roofing accessories markets, Gibraltar Building Products has extensive scale, top brands such as AirVent, Amerimax, Appleton Supply, Architectural Mailboxes, Award Metals, Berger, DOT Metals, Flamco, Florence, NorWesCo, Nu-Ray Metals, Millenium Metals, Quality Aluminum Products, SBC Supply, Southeastern Metals and Verde. Our portfolio of Brands can be found in the nation's largest home center retailers and building product distributors. Gibraltar Building Products is a segment of Gibraltar Industries, Inc (Nasdaq: Rock) a leading manufacturer and provider of products and services for the Residential, Agtech, and Infrastructure markets.
